title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
abstract: arXiv:2608.26958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. translated_title: 扩展模型生成的蒸馏数据可使潜在教师特征更易被恢复
translated_abstract: 扩展模型生成的数据通常被视为改进蒸馏：更多示例应增加覆盖范围、减少噪声并产生更强的学生模型。我们展示了第二种效应：更大的数据集可以使训练后的学生模型中教师特有的微妙信号更易被检测，即使示例与任务无关且从未提及该特征。在受潜意识学习启发的受控设置中，被诱导表达目标特征的教师生成受限的离任务数据，如仅数字的补全。训练在不同数量的独立离任务数据上的学生模型在单独领域中进行评估，并匹配无特征对照组以隔离目标特定迁移。我们的主要发现是，更大的独立数据集使教师的诱导特征在学生后续行为中更清晰地突显。其他可能特征也可能随规模增强，但目标通常增长更多。当小规模学生模型已经...（原文未完整）
tldr: 本文发现，扩展模型生成的蒸馏数据量不仅提升学生性能，还能增强教师潜在特征在学生行为中的可恢复性，即使数据与任务无关且未明确提及该特征。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that scaling model-generated distillation data not only improves student performance but also enhances the recoverability of latent teacher traits in student behavior, even when the data is off-task and never explicitly mentions the trait.
